result.instructions: Tools for Sellsy, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices are late or unpaid, and how much does each customer owe?"; "Find the company Dupont and list its contacts, open opportunities and latest estimates."; "Show my open opportunities in the sales pipeline with their amounts and due dates.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sellsy data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sellsy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sellsy_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sellsy_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. sellsy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sellsy_search
tools.title: Search across Sellsy
tools.description: Free-text search over companies, individuals, contacts, opportunities, items, documents and staff in one call (GET /search). Use it to find a record by name, email or number when you do not know its type. Needs the search.read scope.

type.description: Restrict to these object types or subtypes (e.g. company.client, document.invoice). Omit to search everything.

tools.title: Create an individual
tools.description: WRITE: create an individual (a private person as prospect, client or supplier) in Sellsy. Needs individuals.write.

tools.name: sellsy_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact (a person) in Sellsy. It is not linked to a company by this call. Needs contacts.write.

tools.name: sellsy_create_opportunity
tools.title: Create an opportunity
tools.description: WRITE: create a sales opportunity linked to a company, individual or contact. Needs a pipeline id and one of its step ids (see sellsy_list_opportunity_pipelines and sellsy_list_pipeline_steps). Needs opportunities.write.

related.description: Who it is for: one company or one individual (required), plus optional contacts.

amount.description: Potential amount as a decimal string, e.g. "1500.00" (account currency).

owner_id.description: Staff id of the owner (default: the API client's staff).

tools.name: sellsy_create_comment
tools.title: Add a comment (note)
tools.description: WRITE: add a comment (note) to a company, individual, contact, opportunity or document. Visible to the Sellsy staff, not sent to the customer. Needs comments.write.

tools.name: sellsy_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: WRITE: create a task, optionally attached to a record and assigned to staff. Needs a label id (see sellsy_list_task_labels) and a due date-time. Needs tasks.write.

due_date.description: Due date and time, ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-11-03T09:00:00+01:00.

related_type.description: Record the task is about (give related_id too).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Sellsy
prompts.description: What you can do with Sellsy here, with example requests to try.
